# @aponiajs/nitro

> Delivery adapter that mounts an Aponia application inside Nitro.

## What this package exports

- `toNitroHandler(application)`.
- `defineAponiaHandler(application)`.

## Behavior

- `toNitroHandler` returns a Nitro server-route handler built with `defineHandler`.
- The runtime forwards its request to `application.handle`.
- Aponia guards, validation, filters, and error mapping still run inside the application.
- WebSockets remain Elysia-only.
